title: Starter: Rebuild Perspective
summary: A neutral two-point perspective scaffold to copy for a rebuild: an upright pinhole camera set from a horizon row and two finite vanishing points, so every receding edge is a projected world line. Placeholders only (two plain blocks with panel grids seen across their corners, a ground plane with paving joints, a plain sky); its frame passes the lofi frame gate.
request: No user request: a new starter planned in docs/PLAN-library.md section 6.2 (`starter-rebuild-perspective`, script runtime, status starter): an empty piece for the rebuild mode, in two-point perspective rather than an isometric preset, that renders and passes the gate empty.
